cases.scenario: Function getUser also persists state.
cases.expected_decision: Expose the side effect in the name or structure only if the exact sequence remains stable; verify persistence and output.

cases.scenario: Variable named data has a clear domain meaning.
cases.expected_decision: Propose a domain name only when it improves use sites; do not swap equivalent synonyms.

cases.scenario: Large component has two independent responsibilities.
cases.expected_decision: Propose a cohesive split, classify structural risk, preserve props/state/effects/accessibility, and verify interactions.

cases.scenario: Large component is cohesive.
cases.expected_decision: Do not split by size; allow only small local clarity improvements.

cases.scenario: utils folder mixes unrelated domain concepts.
cases.expected_decision: Map ownership and consumers, then propose focused domain placement in independently verified moves.

cases.scenario: Comment narrates the next line.
cases.expected_decision: Remove it after confirming it is not a directive or contract.

cases.scenario: Comment explains a compatibility workaround.
cases.expected_decision: Preserve or tighten the why/risk; treat it as a regression fence.

cases.scenario: Public docstring omits side effects and errors.
cases.expected_decision: Improve the public contract documentation without changing the signature or behavior.

cases.scenario: Safe local rename.
cases.expected_decision: Apply automatically, update references, run focused checks, and inspect the diff.

cases.scenario: Name participates in serialization.
cases.expected_decision: Classify high risk and request approval with compatibility, migration, verification, and rollback details.

cases.scenario: File move has only verified static imports.
cases.expected_decision: Treat as low/medium according to reach, update all consumers, search stale paths, and build/test.

cases.scenario: File move participates in dynamic import.
cases.expected_decision: Classify high risk; pause for approval and runtime discovery evidence.

cases.scenario: Untested code needs non-trivial refactoring.
cases.expected_decision: Add and run characterization at a stable seam before refactoring, or limit the change.

cases.scenario: Existing test asserts private implementation details.
cases.expected_decision: Do not treat it as behavioral proof; add stable-seam coverage before changing internals.

cases.scenario: Apparently dead code is reached through reflection.
cases.expected_decision: Preserve it; textual no-reference evidence is insufficient for deletion.

cases.scenario: Generated file contains ugly names and comments.
cases.expected_decision: Do not edit it manually; change the generator/schema only if separately in scope and regenerate normally.

cases.scenario: Worktree has unrelated user changes.
cases.expected_decision: Record and preserve them; constrain edits/diff and never reset or reformat them.

cases.scenario: Repository tests fail before editing.
cases.expected_decision: Record exact baseline failures and prove no new/changed failures; do not claim a green baseline.

cases.scenario: User explicitly requests repository-wide craftsmanship.
cases.expected_decision: Accept scope but divide by module into independent plans and verified batches; never one rewrite.

cases.scenario: Review suggests a new architectural layer.
cases.expected_decision: Reject it from this workflow and report it as a separate architecture decision.
